integrity: All mathematical claims in this package are supported by an explicit analytic derivation; numerical diagnostics are separately identified and are not an independent audit.
limitations: The theorem is a joint lower-tail asymptotic for random orthogonal views of the specified regular tetrahedron, not a complete distribution or a theorem for all tetrahedra. The 2001 Vickers–Brown full text was inaccessible and historical priority remains provisional. Finite experiments do not certify the asymptotic proof.
title: A third-order silhouette-type bias at minimum projected area of a regular tetrahedron
